item.title: U.S. war on Iran will end when Trump feels 'objectives' are met, White House says
Why Trump can't afford to brush off the Iran war's economic impact
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is trying to downplay the effect of the Iran war on the domestic economy even as American drivers are already feeling the impact on their wallets every time they fill up their cars and trucks.

item.title: Trump says war in Iran could be over soon, but U.S. hasn't 'won enough' yet
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump hinted on Monday that the war in the Middle East could be over soon — though not this week, he specified — even as hardliners pledged loyalty to their new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

item.title: Video appears to contradict Trump claim that U.S. wasn't responsible for deadly Minab school blast
item.summary: New footage shows what an expert investigative group says is likely an American Tomahawk missile hitting a compound in southern Iran, metres from the school where a deadly unclaimed blast killed more than 165 people at the start of the war raging in the Middle East.

item.title: FIFA World Cup COO says tournament 'too big' to be postponed amid global turmoil
item.summary: FIFA's World Cup chief operating officer says the tournament is "too big" to be postponed because of global turmoil caused by the U.S. and Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: IN PHOTOS | Satellite images of damage in Iran, Gulf nations
item.summary: Satellite images show the damage to naval bases, airports and other key facilities inside Iran since the U.S.-Israel attacks began Feb. 28, as well as damage from Iran's retaliatory strikes on Persian Gulf neighbours.

item.title: Is 'oil rain' really falling in Iran? | About That
item.summary: Andrew Chang explains how burning oil from depots hit by U.S.-Israeli airstrikes is falling as black rain over parts of Iran, and the danger it poses. Images provided by The Canadian Press, Reuters and Getty Images

item.title: IN PHOTOS | Day 10: U.S.-Israel war with Iran
item.summary: Iran marked the naming of Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei to replace his father as its supreme leader with a new barrage of missiles against Israel and Persian Gulf nations on Monday, as the Mideast war sent oil prices soaring.

item.title: Iran’s allies and foes, explained
item.summary: Countries across the Middle East are being pulled into the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. How long will their opposition to Iran hold?

item.title: Dozens of Haitian civilians killed by police, security company drones in past year, Human Rights Watch says
item.summary: Drones operated by Haitian security forces and private contractors have killed at least 1,243 people and injured 738 others in less than a year, Human Rights Watch said Tuesday.
